story: How bad is my gas stove?
text: Chef Jon Kung posted a video talking about cooking on induction that features a rounded induction cooktop for woks: [VIDEO]

It's true that most induction cooktops/ranges aren't great for woks, but in principle the induction surface doesn't have to be flat -- it can be a concave shape to match the wok. In fact these exist -- if you search for "induction wok burners" you can see some pictures. (I only recently became aware of this after watching this video of a chef who uses induction cooking in a small kitchen: [VIDEO] ) Perhaps in the future there will be cooktops that include a wok depression on the surface, similar to how some gas stoves today include a built-in wok ring.

story: Chipotle plans to ditch gas grills at 100 new locations
text: > Doing a decent stir fry is all but impossible on either induction or standard electric. Not really. Jon Kung makes the positive case for an induction wok better than I can: [VIDEO] .
